recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If maintainers want the external FHIR Testing IG to repeat the core HTEST guidance, handle that separately in the IG; no FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-16383.
issue_request: FHIR-16383 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked for clearer instructions on where to indicate that a resource is test data, including references to v3 ActReason HTEST on testing/security-label/tag guidance and HTEST marking in examples.*.zip.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 13959, mirrored as git commit ebfe68feb5e7a9145fb75fb5e75d43f4a8e6f5dc, which added HTEST guidance to security-labels.html and testing.html and changed the then-in-repo publisher to mark generated example packages. The related earlier FHIR-10580 issue added the broader secpriv-module 'Using FHIR to publish test data' section.
additional_context: The old source/testing.html page and TestPlan/TestScript/TestReport resources were later removed from core by f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 when testing resources moved to the FHIR Testing IG. Current core still links to that IG and retains active HTEST guidance in security-labels.html and secpriv-module.html.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because current core pages still tell implementers to use HTEST for test data, and current build examples-json.zip/examples.zip checks show HTEST remains present for the relevant generated example resources.
